# Summary

Examine distribution of projected species and functional entity (FE) turnover (or similarity) within regions (MEOW realm/province), split by coastal (neritic) vs. open ocean (oceanic).

# Methods

## Load turnover and biomass rasters

Species and FE turnover rasters (created in community and functional change scripts) are already in Behrmann equal-area projection at 5 km resolution. Use the RCP4.5 scenario throughout. Include species/FE richness (also RCP4.5) to drop cells where richness falls below a threshold (20), to ensure turnover values are based on a reasonable number of taxa. Include a coastal/oceanic mask (from GEBCO bathymetry, <= 200 m = coastal) and a MEOW ecoregion raster to facilitate the by-region comparison.

```{r build analysis dataframe}
spp_turn_r  <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_turnover.tif'))[['rcp45_2050']] %>%
  setNames('spp_turnover')
fe_turn_r   <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_turnover.tif'))[['rcp45_2050']] %>%
  setNames('fe_turnover')

nspp_r <- rast(here('_output/spp_turnover_maps/all_spp_richness.tif'))[['rcp45_2050']] %>%
  setNames('nspp')
nfe_r  <- rast(here('_output/fe_turnover_maps/all_fe_richness.tif'))[['rcp45_2050']] %>%
  setNames('nfe')

### Coastal (<= 200 m) vs. oceanic (> 200 m), from GEBCO bathymetry,
### reprojected/aligned to the turnover raster grid (Behrmann, 5 km)
bathy_r_4326 <- rast(here('_data/gebco_2026/GEBCO_2026_sub_ice_0.05.nc'))
bathy_r_4326[bathy_r_4326 >= -200] <- 1 ### coastal (neritic)
bathy_r_4326[bathy_r_4326 <  -200] <- 2 ### oceanic
coastal_r <- project(bathy_r_4326, spp_turn_r) %>%
  round() %>%
  mask(spp_turn_r) %>%
  setNames('coastal')

meow_r <- rast(here('_data/mregions_2026/meow_eco_code.tif')) %>%
  setNames('eco_code')

turnover_df <- c(spp_turn_r, fe_turn_r, nspp_r, nfe_r, coastal_r, meow_r) %>%
  as.data.frame(xy = TRUE) %>%
  fmutate(coastal = ifelse(coastal == 1, 'neritic', 'oceanic'))
```

## Examine turnover by ecoregion

```{r set up MEOW realm and province lookup}
meow_lookup <- read_csv(here('_data/mregions_2026/meow_lookup_complete.csv'), 
                        show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
  janitor::clean_names() %>%
  arrange(prov_code) %>%
  mutate(realm_lbl = str_replace(realm, 'Temperate', 'Temp'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Tropical', 'Trop'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Northern', 'N'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Western', 'W'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Eastern', 'E'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'South(ern)?', 'S'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Central', 'C'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Atlantic', 'Atl'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Pacific', 'Pac'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Africa', 'Afr'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'America', 'Amer'),
         realm_lbl = str_replace(realm_lbl, 'Australasia', 'Aus'),
         realm_lbl = fct_inorder(realm_lbl)) %>%
  mutate(prov_lbl = str_replace(province, 'Temperate', 'Temp'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, 'Tropical', 'Trop'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, 'North(ern)?', 'N'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, '(W|w)est(ern)?', 'W'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, '(E|e)ast(ern)?(?!er)', 'E'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, 'South(ern)?', 'S'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, 'Islands', 'Is'),
         prov_lbl = str_replace(prov_lbl, ', | and ', '/'),
         prov_lbl = fct_inorder(prov_lbl))

meow_turnover_df <- turnover_df %>%
  left_join(meow_lookup, by = 'eco_code') %>%
  filter(!is.na(prov_lbl))
```

### Pivot longer

Unlike the CHI data, the spp and fe turnover metrics are all pretty normally distributed.  Let's use raw turnover scores (0-1).

```{r build species and FE long dataframes}

long_df <- meow_turnover_df %>%
    # filter(nspp >= 20) %>%
    ### use turnover as-is (scale 0-1), biomass as 1 + reduction
    select(prov_lbl, realm_lbl, coastal, spp = spp_turnover, fe = fe_turnover) %>%
    pivot_longer(names_to = 'metric', values_to = 'score', cols = c(spp, fe)) %>%
    mutate(zone = ifelse(coastal == 'neritic', 'c', 'o'),
           method_zone = paste(metric, zone, sep = '_'))
```

### Plot by realm

```{r figure realm dataframes, fig.height = 8}
### Order realms by latitude - in original order, plus a "Global" pseudo-realm

order_by_prov_median <- function(df, order_zone = 'simil_c') {
  prov_order <- df %>%
    filter(method_zone == order_zone) %>%
    group_by(prov_lbl, realm_lbl) %>%
    summarize(med = median(score, na.rm = TRUE), .groups = 'drop') %>%
    arrange(realm_lbl, med) %>%
    pull(prov_lbl)
  df %>% mutate(prov_lbl = factor(prov_lbl, levels = prov_order))
}

add_global_realm <- function(df) {
  global_df <- df %>% mutate(realm_lbl = 'Global')
  global_df %>%
    bind_rows(df) %>%
    select(-prov_lbl) %>%
    mutate(realm_lbl = fct_inorder(realm_lbl) %>% fct_rev())
}

prov_df  <- long_df %>% order_by_prov_median()

realm_df <- prov_df %>% add_global_realm()
```

``` {r plot function for turnover and impact by realm}
plot_realm <- function(df, x_label) {
  
  div_clr <- c('#e66101', '#5e3c99')
  fills <- c(div_clr[1], colorspace::lighten(div_clr[1], .7), 
             div_clr[2], colorspace::lighten(div_clr[2], .7))
  clrs  <- c(div_clr[1], div_clr[1],
             div_clr[2], div_clr[2])
  lbls <- c(spp_c = latex2exp::TeX('$Spp_{coastal}$'),
            spp_o = latex2exp::TeX('$Spp_{ocean}$'),
            fe_c = latex2exp::TeX('$FE_{coastal}$'),
            fe_o = latex2exp::TeX('$FE_{ocean}$'))

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(method_zone = factor(method_zone, levels = names(lbls)) |> fct_rev())

  means_df <- plot_df %>%
    drop_na() %>%
    group_by(realm_lbl, method_zone) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), 
              med  = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop')
  
  ggplot(plot_df, 
         aes(y = realm_lbl, x = score, 
             fill = method_zone, color = method_zone)) +
    geom_boxplot(width = .4, 
                 position = position_dodge(width = .75),
                 outlier.shape = NA, 
                 size = .25) +
    geom_point(data = means_df,
               aes(x = med, group = method_zone),
               position = position_dodge(width = .75),
               size = 1, shape = 21, color = 'black', fill = 'black') +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fills, 
                      breaks = names(lbls), 
                      labels = lbls,
                      guide = guide_legend(label.position = 'left')) +
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs, 
                       breaks = names(lbls), 
                       labels = lbls,
                       guide = guide_legend(label.position = 'left')) +
    # scale_x_continuous(limits = c(-2, 2), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(x = x_label) +
    theme(text = element_text(family = 'Arial'),
          axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_text(size = 8),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.x = element_blank(),
          legend.text  = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 8),
          legend.key.size = unit(.25, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_blank())
}

fig4 <- plot_realm(df = realm_df, x_label = 'Turnover')

fig4_file <- here('ms_figs/fig4_turnover_biomass_by_ecoregion.png')
ggsave(fig4_file, width = 3.5, height = 5.2, units = 'in', dpi = 300)

knitr::include_graphics(fig4_file)
```

### Plot by province (SI)

``` {r plot function for turnover and impact by province}
plot_prov <- function(df, x_label, strips) {

  div_clr <- c('#e66101', '#5e3c99')
  fills <- c(div_clr[1], 'white', div_clr[2], 'white')
  clrs  <- c(div_clr[1], div_clr[1], div_clr[2], div_clr[2])

  lbls <- c(simil_c = latex2exp::TeX('$Similarity_c$'),
            simil_o = latex2exp::TeX('$Similarity_o$'),
            biomass_c = latex2exp::TeX('$Biomass_c$'),
            biomass_o = latex2exp::TeX('$Biomass_o$'))

  plot_df <- df %>%
    mutate(method_zone = factor(method_zone, levels = names(lbls)))
  means_df <- plot_df %>%
    group_by(realm_lbl, prov_lbl, method_zone) %>%
    summarize(mean = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), 
              med  = median(score, na.rm = TRUE),
              .groups = 'drop')
  
  p <- ggplot(plot_df, 
              aes(y = prov_lbl, x = score, fill = method_zone, color = method_zone))
  if(strips) {
    p <- p + geom_vline(xintercept = 100, color = 'black', size = 2)
  }
  
  p <- p +
    geom_boxplot(width = .4, position = position_dodge(width = .75),
                 outlier.shape = NA, size = .25) +
    geom_point(data = means_df,
               aes(x = med, group = method_zone), 
               position = position_dodge(width = .75),
               size = 1, shape = 21, color = 'black', fill = 'black') +
    scale_fill_manual(values = fills, 
                      breaks = names(lbls), 
                      labels = lbls,
                      guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE,
                                           label.position = 'left')) +
    scale_color_manual(values = clrs, 
                       breaks = names(lbls), 
                       labels = lbls,
                       guide = guide_legend(reverse = TRUE,
                                            label.position = 'left')) +
    scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 100), expand = c(0, 0)) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.title.x = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 8),
          axis.text  = element_text(size = 8),
          panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
          panel.grid.minor.y = element_blank(),
          legend.text  = element_text(face = 'bold', size = 8),
          legend.key.size = unit(.25, 'cm'),
          legend.title = element_blank()) +
    facet_grid(rows = vars(realm_lbl), 
               scales = 'free_y', space = 'free_y') +
    labs(x = x_label)
  
  if(strips) {
    p <- p +
      theme(strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = .5, 
                                        face = 'bold', size = 8))
  } else {
    p <- p + 
      theme(strip.background = element_blank(),
            strip.text = element_blank())
    }
  
  return(p)
}

panel_a_SI <- plot_prov(df = spp_prov_df, 
                        x_label = 'Species similarity / relative biomass',
                        strips = FALSE)

panel_b_SI <- plot_prov(df = fe_prov_df, 
                        x_label = 'FE similarity / relative biomass',
                        strips = TRUE)

```

```{r assemble figure SI}
panel_a_SI_plot <- panel_a_SI + 
  theme(legend.position = 'none')
panel_b_SI_plot <- panel_b_SI +

fig_SI <- ggdraw() +

  draw_plot(panel_b_SI_plot,  x = 0.60, y = 0.00, height = 1.00, width = 0.35) +
  ### draw legend:

  draw_label('B.', x = 0.605, y = .99, hjust = 0, vjust = 1, 
             size = 9, fontfamily = 'Arial', fontface = 'bold')
```
